title: Doctoral Student Programme 2027-1
about: CERN doctoral student contract (TSC-2027-1/DOCT) of 12 to 36 months, onsite in Geneva, ideal start 1 April 2027. The applicant's university must agree that research at CERN contributes to the PhD thesis.
